qualification.parameter_contract: Estimate positive covariance amplitude using noise-adjusted absolute response. Inputs: targets: Nonempty finite real vector.; errors: Aligned finite strictly positive error vector.; relative_floor: Finite nonnegative scalar.; amplitude_fraction: Finite strictly positive scalar. Bounds: Score abs(y)/sqrt(error**2+(relative_floor*max(y))**2); select first maximum and square amplitude_fraction*abs(selected y). Reject nonfinite arithmetic or zero amplitude. Optimize one Matérn32 coordinate length and optionally amplitude with analytic gradients. Inputs: coordinates: Nonempty finite real observation-by-coordinate matrix.; targets: Aligned finite real response vector.; errors: Aligned finite strictly positive error vector.; amplitude: Finite positive covariance variance.; lengths: Finite positive vector matching coordinate width; units match coordinates.; optimized_axis: Python integer selecting one coordinate axis.; metric_log_bounds: Increasing finite two-vector bounding log(length squared).; amplitude_log_radius: Finite positive radius around initial log-amplitude.; fix_amplitude: Python bool; true freezes amplitude.; white_noise_variance: Finite strictly positive scalar white variance. Bounds: Freeze all other lengths. Use george likelihood/gradient and scipy bounded minimize without an extra iteration cap or restarts. On optimizer failure restore initial active parameters while retaining optimizer.x separately, even if diagnostic values are nonfinite. No jitter repair. Multiply a normalized covariance block by amplitude. Inputs: normalized: Nonempty finite real rank-two matrix.; amplitude: Positive finite scalar excluding bool. Bounds: Copy to float64; reject multiplication overflow. Does not prove kernel provenance or positive definiteness. Combine measurement error and explicit white variance. Inputs: errors: Nonempty finite nonnegative real vector.; white_noise_variance: Aligned finite nonnegative real vector. Bounds: Preserve sqrt(error squared + white variance) squared arithmetic; reject overflow. No implicit noise floor. Condition a zero-mean Gaussian process on covariance and diagonal noise. Inputs: covariance: Nonempty finite real exactly symmetric square matrix.; targets: Aligned finite real vector.; noise_variance: Aligned finite nonnegative real vector. Bounds: Add noise to diagonal and use upper Cholesky plus cho_solve. Reject nonfinite arithmetic; singular or non-positive-definite matrices fail. No jitter or repair. Compute zero-mean conditional means and latent marginal variances. Inputs: factor: Finite nonempty square upper-triangular factor with positive diagonal.; alpha: Aligned finite precision-weighted target vector.; cross_covariance: Nonempty finite query-by-training matrix.; prior_variance: Query-aligned finite nonnegative variance vector. Bounds: Mean=cross@alpha; variance=prior-sum(cross.T*cho_solve(factor,cross.T),axis0). Preserve negative roundoff variance; no clipping. All inputs must originate from one model. Balance class contributions by inverse frequency. Inputs: labels: Nonempty pandas Series with unique nonnull index and nonnull homogeneous sortable class labels.; class_weights: None for equal class weights, or mapping covering each observed class with finite positive nonboolean scalars. Bounds: Weight=class_weight*N/count(class), retaining source arithmetic and Series index. Qualified inputs must avoid arithmetic overflow; output finiteness is not independently checked. Stratify originals and assign derivatives to the same fold as their original. Inputs: labels: Nonempty pandas Series with unique nonnull index and nonnull homogeneous sortable class labels.; references: Exactly aligned Series; null denotes original, otherwise points directly to an original of the same class.; num_folds: Python integer at least two; each original class has at least this many members.; seed: Python integer in[0,2**32). Bounds: Use shuffled sklearn StratifiedKFold on originals in supplied order. Reject missing references, chains, conflicting labels and index misalignment. No independence claim beyond supplied references. Normalize score rows using retained unshifted exponentials. Inputs: scores: Nonempty finite real rank-two matrix; qualified comparisons use float64. Bounds: Compute exp(scores)/row_sum(exp(scores)) without maximum subtraction. Reject nonfinite results including overflow or total underflow. Individual zero probabilities are allowed.
